summary_en: FY2026 November dividend per share raised from 25.00 yen to 32.00 yen, a 7-yen increase. Shareholder benefits program expanded: QUO card 5,000 yen replaced with electronic gift 6,000 yen for shareholders holding 300 shares or more, effective November 2026.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase) and Changes and Expansion of Shareholder Benefit Program
translation_en_brief:
Property Technologies Inc. announced on October 15, 2026, a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026. The annual dividend per share has been increased from the previously announced 25.00 yen to 32.00 yen, representing a 7-yen increase. The prior fiscal year (FY2025 November) paid a dividend of 25.00 yen. The company cited favorable earnings performance and overall financial conditions as the basis for the upward revision, while maintaining a policy of balancing stable dividends with sufficient retained earnings for strengthening competitive advantage and efficient organizational structure.

Concurrently, the company expanded its shareholder benefit program effective with shareholders recorded in the register as of November 30, 2026. The shareholder benefit offer for holders of 300 shares or more has been enhanced: the QUO card benefit of 5,000 yen was replaced with an electronic gift worth 6,000 yen. The company stated this change aims to increase investment appeal, broaden shareholder base, and improve liquidity in trading of its shares. Further details on the electronic gift catalog were to be announced separately.
